description: Clean benchmark of the F-actin interface score with validated binders/non-binders and LRCH placement
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
df=pd.read_csv('ch_work/iface_conservation_v2.csv')
BAD={'UTRN_HUMAN_CH1','UTRN_HUMAN_CH2','DMD_HUMAN_CH1','DMD_HUMAN_CH2'}
d=df[~df.domain.isin(BAD)].copy()
selfmask=np.array([(r=='UTRN_CH1' and dm=='UTRN_HUMAN_CH1') or (r=='FLNA_CH1' and dm=='FLNA_HUMAN_CH1')
                   for r,dm in zip(d.ref,d.domain)])
d=d[~selfmask]
LAB={'ACTN1_HUMAN_CH1':'binds','FLNA_HUMAN_CH1':'binds','PLST_HUMAN_CH1':'binds','PLST_HUMAN_CH3':'binds',
     'PARVA_HUMAN_CH2':'binds','IQGA1_HUMAN_CH':'binds','SMTN_HUMAN_CH':'binds',
     'SMTL1_MOUSE_CH':'not','SMTL1_HUMAN_CH':'not','MARE1_HUMAN_CH':'not','VAV_HUMAN_CH':'not','CNN1_HUMAN_CH':'not'}
m=d.groupby('domain')['pct_class'].mean().reset_index().rename(columns={'pct_class':'score'})
m['class']=m.domain.map(lambda x: LAB.get(x,'unknown'))
m=m.sort_values('score',ascending=False)
pd.set_option('display.width',200); print(m.to_string(index=False))
b=m[m['class']=='binds'].score.values; nb=m[m['class']=='not'].score.values
L=float(m[m.domain=='LRCH1_HUMAN_CH'].score.iloc[0])
print(f"\nvalidated binders    n={len(b)}: mean {b.mean():.1f}, range {b.min():.1f}-{b.max():.1f}")
print(f"validated non-binders n={len(nb)}: mean {nb.mean():.1f}, range {nb.min():.1f}-{nb.max():.1f}")
print("Mann-Whitney (binders > non-binders) one-sided p = %.4f"%stats.mannwhitneyu(b,nb,alternative='greater').pvalue)
print("AUC = %.2f"%np.mean([(x>y)+0.5*(x==y) for x in b for y in nb]))
print(f"LRCH1 = {L:.1f}: below all {len(b)} binders and all {len(nb)} non-binders")
print("LRCH family:",{x:round(float(m[m.domain==x].score.iloc[0]),1) for x in
      ['LRCH1_HUMAN_CH','LRCH2_HUMAN_CH','LRCH3_HUMAN_CH','LRCH4_HUMAN_CH','LRCH_DROME_CH']})
m.to_csv('ch_work/benchmark_scores_clean.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6.8))
col={'binds':'#2f855a','not':'#b7791f','unknown':'#a0aec0'}
mm=m.sort_values('score')
ax.barh(range(len(mm)),mm.score,color=[('#c53030' if 'LRCH' in dd else col[c]) for dd,c in zip(mm.domain,mm['class'])])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(mm))); ax.set_yticklabels(mm.domain,fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(b.min(),ls='--',c='#2f855a',lw=1); ax.axvline(nb.max(),ls='--',c='#b7791f',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('% of cryo-EM F-actin contact positions with conserved residue class\n(mean of utrophin CH1 and filamin A CH1 frames, self-comparisons removed)')
ax.set_title('LRCH CH domains score below every validated CH actin binder and non-binder')
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color='#2f855a',label='F-actin binding shown experimentally'),
                   mp.Patch(color='#b7791f',label='F-actin binding tested, negative'),
                   mp.Patch(color='#a0aec0',label='not labelled'),
                   mp.Patch(color='#c53030',label='LRCH family')],fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
